sentences: That scene where Indy just *shoots* the swordsman? It was *never* in the script.
Originally, they were supposed to have this huge, long *whip* fight.
But *Harrison Ford* had *dysentery* that day, and he could barely even stand.
So he goes to *Spielberg*, why don't I just *shoot* the guy?
And honestly? It ended up being one of the *funniest* scenes in the whole movie.
